import unittest
from cache import Cache
from consumer import page
class Tests(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_empty(self):
  calls=[]
  def load(k): calls.append(k); return []
  c=Cache()
  self.assertEqual(page(c,load),[])
  self.assertEqual(page(c,load),[])
  self.assertEqual(calls,["items"])
  c.clear(); page(c,load)
  self.assertEqual(calls,["items","items"])
